---
title: "Statistical Animation Gallery"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: false
    css: style.css
---
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, results="asis", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))
```

<div class="header">
  <h1>Animation Gallery</h1>
  <p>Interactive Statistical Visualizations with Animint2</p>
</div>
```{r stats}
meta <- fread("meta.csv")
cat(paste0("<div class="stats-box"><p class="stats-number">", nrow(meta), "</p><p class="stats-label">Interactive Visualizations</p></div>"))
```

<div class="viz-grid">
```{r gallery}
for(i in 1:nrow(meta)) {
  row <- meta[i,]
  img_path <- paste0("repos/", gsub("/", "_", row$viz_owner_repo), ".png")
  owner <- sub("/.*", "", row$viz_owner_repo)
  repo <- sub(".*/", "", row$viz_owner_repo)
  viz_url <- paste0("https://", owner, ".github.io/", repo, "/")
  repo_url <- paste0("https://github.com/", row$viz_owner_repo)
  
  cat(paste0(
    "<div class="viz-card">",
    "<a href="", viz_url, "" target="_blank">",
    "<img src="", img_path, "" class="viz-image" alt="", row$title, ""/>",
    "</a>",
    "<div class="viz-content">",
    "<h3 class="viz-title">", row$title, "</h3>",
    "<div class="viz-links">",
    "<a href="", viz_url, "" target="_blank">View Live</a>",
    "<a href="", repo_url, "" target="_blank">Repository</a>",
    "<a href="", row$source, "" target="_blank">Source Code</a>",
    "</div></div></div>"
  ))
}
```

</div>

<div class="footer">
  <p>Built with animint2 | <a href="meta.csv" style="color: #667eea;">Download Data</a></p>
</div>
